EDGE_04ef2f7daccf4d5dce.evidence: Text: 'For the catalytic pyrolysis, the catalyst was put in the both sides of the materials... The carrier gas was N2 (99.999 %) with a flow rate of 150 mL/min... When the temperature was increased to 550 °C, the sample was placed to the high temperature zone quickly and was pyrolyzed for 5min... then was again placed in the low temperature zone rapidly... After the temperature reached to 700 °C of the second step, the sample was placed to the high temperature zone rapidly and pyrolyzed for 40min.' This base procedure implies a non-catalytic condition (no catalyst), as catalyst is added only for catalytic runs. It describes a distinct experimental condition combination: feedstocks EP+PP, two-step temperatures 550°C then 700°C, no catalyst.
